summary: Iteration 7: Verified the primary bug fix — desktop Services mega-menu is now SOLID/OPAQUE (bg rgb(10,15,26), alpha=1.0) and no longer transparent. All 4 pillar groups (BUILD, BRAND, MARKET, AUTOMATE) render with service links + taglines. Bottom 'Explore all services' row (data-testid nav-all-services) links to /services and is visible. Panel stays within viewport at 1920 (left=495, right=1255) and 1280 widths. Responsive nav confirmed: full horizontal menu at 1280/1920, hamburger (data-testid mobile-menu-open) hidden on desktop; at 390 hamburger visible, opens drawer with All Services link. Navbar logo (data-testid navbar-logo-image) has transparent bg (rgba(0,0,0,0)), 80x80, /pt-logo.png. Backend regression: 10/10 pytest cases pass — home/services/pricing/careers/admin all 200, unknown route 404, email settings show enabled=true & hasPassword=true & enabledEnquiries=true, POST /api/leads returns 200 and lead's emailStatus flips to 'sent' when polled from GET /api/leads, POST /api/careers/apply (multipart) returns 200.
action_items: Old test file /app/backend/tests/test_pytech_iter6.py has 3 stale assertions (asserts enabled/hasPassword are False) — should be deleted or updated since Gmail is now LIVE. iter7 test supersedes it.
critical_code_review_comments: navbar.js mega-menu correctly uses bg-[hsl(var(--popover))] which resolves to solid rgb(10,15,26) — fully opaque, addresses the transparency bug.
Hover-based menu without keyboard/focus trigger — for a11y, consider also opening on focus for keyboard users (Radix Popover/DropdownMenu would give this for free).

Real Gmail is being sent on every /api/leads POST — during backend tests we generated 1 real lead + 1 real application (real emails delivered to rajeev.pytech@gmail.com). User acknowledged this is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: 1 lead (TEST_Lead_iter7_<timestamp>) with emailStatus='sent' and 1 application (TEST_Applicant_iter7 / applicant_iter7@example.com) written to MongoDB via API; real emails delivered by live Gmail SMTP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://pytech-hardened.preview.emergentagent.com. All 10 iter7 pytest cases green. Mega-menu bug is FIXED. Gmail SMTP is LIVE (enabled=true, hasPassword=true) — POSTs to /api/leads and /api/careers/apply send real mail to rajeev.pytech@gmail.com; use TEST_ prefix for names. Occasional cold-start 502 on first hit — iter7 tests already retry 3x. /api/careers/apply requires multipart/form-data only. Old iter6 tests are stale (asserted Gmail disabled) — safe to delete.
rca of the issue: Original transparency: mega-menu panel used a semi-transparent background so hero WebGL globe + text bled through. Fix in navbar.js changed the panel container to bg-[hsl(var(--popover))] which is solid rgb(10,15,26) (alpha=1.0) with ring/shadow — verified via getComputedStyle in a real desktop browser session.
